en: <CLT=cltMIND>I'm chatting with Keebo again today, but...
...Kaede, is something troubling you?
N-No! It's nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>To be honest, something's been bothering me,
and I can't really focus on our conversation.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a button on Keebo's neck...
What does it do?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's calling out to me...
I wanna push the button!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*thud!*
Hm? What was that sound?

<CLT=cltMIND>Whatever that sound was, it occurred at the
exact right time...

<CLT=cltMIND>Because when Keebo turned around, his
neck was completely defenseless...

<CLT=cltMIND>Oh, god! The button is like screaming,
"Don't push me! Don't push me!"
<CLT=cltMIND>But I'm definitely gonna push the button!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click!*
<CLT=cltMIND>No reaction...?
Keebo!?
<CLT=cltMIND>I called his name and circled around him...
Whaaaaat!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo was completely frozen!
Like a toy out of batteries...

<CLT=cltMIND>M-Maybe that was the emergency stop
button!?

Wh-What should I do!?
Maybe if I push it again, it'll fix him...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Hoping that was the case, I pressed the
button again.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click!*
Wha—!?

Kaede, why are you in front of me?
Weren't you behind me earlier?
A-And why are you so close to me?
I-I'm so glad... You're back to normal...
Huh? What do you mean?

U-Um...well, I noticed a button on your
neck, so I pushed it.
What—!? You discovered this button!?

I-I'm so sorry! It was tempting me!
Was that the emergency stop button?

...Yes. It's there just in case my AI or
essential functions encounter problems.
I didn't know you had such a function...
Kaede...you know my secret now...

I-If it's a secret, then you should've hid
it better!

But what good is an emergency button that
cannot be easily found in an emergency?

But there are people who might push it for
fun...like me...

...That's true. I will forward your feedback to
the professor when we get out of here.
Yeah, good idea...

But...Kaede, that means you will have
influenced my design.

Which means you will have played a role in my
creation.
Huh? You're exaggerating.

It's no exaggeration. If Professor Idabashi
can be considered my "father"...

Then you, Kaede, will be my "mother."
So I shall call you mom.
M-M-Mom!? What!?
...That was a joke.
U-Um...

It's payback for messing with my body.
You deserve at least that much.

Ha...hahaha...
I'm so sorry, Keebo.
<CLT=cltMIND>A robot making a joke... That's pretty cool.
<CLT=cltMIND>The title of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltMIND> really suits him.

Um, Kaede... Do you think you can keep
that button a secret from everyone?
Yeah, don't worry.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi definitely can't find out about this
button. That would be a huge problem...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>K1-B0's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Keebo, I returned
to my room.
